envelope.description: Add bounded replay of retained turn prefixes

body.title: Add bounded replay of retained turn prefixes
body.summary: Extend SessionOutput.tail with additive fromTurnStart/beforeOffset options using the matching turn marker in the recorded generation. Read only complete lines before the saved offset, without polling or crossing segment boundaries; retain default tail behavior. Add temporary-file regressions for multiple turns, rollover, byte boundaries, abort and SegmentGone.
acceptanceChecks: Prefix scan starts at the requested turn marker, stops before saved offset and never yields other turns or incomplete boundary lines.
Prefix scan does not wait for live writer; abort and missing/rolled segment behavior remain explicit.
Existing SessionOutput default-tail tests pass; cursor/marker schemas unchanged.

tests.name: bounded prefix selects only requested turn and complete pre-checkpoint lines
bounded prefix terminates while writer lives; abort, rotated generation and missing marker
